summary: Your Arabic site has doctors, 623 reviews and a booking form, but the English version, messaging options and several details lose patients.

findings.problem: The English version appears to be only a stub, with a Book Appointment heading and a divider.
findings.cost: Expats and visitors who read English cannot use the site.
findings.fix: A full English version of every key page.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp anywhere. Four phone numbers are listed, and the phone links contain spaces (tel:+966 11 4836060).
findings.cost: Saudi patients message first, and links that fail lose calls.
findings.fix: A WhatsApp button and tested click to call links.

findings.problem: Several reviews show only a name with no text, one doctor uses a default placeholder photo, and the specialities menu does nothing when clicked.
findings.cost: Empty reviews and placeholders look unfinished.
findings.fix: Real reviews, doctor photos and working menus.

findings.problem: The home page has repeated buttons (book twice in a row), no address or map, no before and after, and some spelling errors.
findings.cost: Patients do not know where you are or what results to expect.
findings.fix: Address and map, results gallery and clean copy.

redesign: Arabic and English versions with a WhatsApp and booking button.
Real reviews, doctor photos, address map and a results gallery.
